properties.name: ono.observability.enabled
properties.description: Master switch to enable or disable the observability auto-configuration.

properties.name: ono.observability.logging.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable correlation ID propagation via the web filter.

properties.name: ono.observability.logging.correlationHeader
properties.description: HTTP header name used to propagate the correlation ID.

properties.name: ono.observability.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable Micrometer common tag configuration.

properties.name: ono.observability.metrics.serviceName
properties.description: Service name applied as a common Micrometer tag.

properties.name: ono.observability.tracing.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable distributed tracing configuration.

properties.name: ono.observability.aop.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the AOP aspect for @LogExecution and @TimedExecution annotations.

properties.name: ono.observability.aop.slowThresholdMs
properties.description: Threshold in milliseconds above which a method execution is considered slow.

properties.name: ono.observability.exceptions.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the global exception handler provided by the observability starter.

properties.name: ono.observability.http.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable HTTP request/response logging via Logbook.

properties.name: ono.observability.http.excludePaths
properties.description: URL path patterns excluded from HTTP logging.

properties.name: ono.observability.http.maskHeaders
properties.description: HTTP header names whose values are masked in logs.

properties.name: ono.observability.http.maskBodyFields
properties.description: JSON body field names whose values are masked in logs.
